questions.question: How can you show your love to your parents?
questions.translation: كيف يمكنك أن تُظهر حبك لوالديك؟
suggested_answers: I can show my love by telling them what is on my mind and helping them.
I show my love by respecting them, listening to them, and spending time with them.
I can be kind and support my parents to show my love.

questions.question: How can you be a good example to your siblings?
questions.translation: كيف يمكنك أن تكون قدوة حسنة لأشقائك؟
suggested_answers: I can help my siblings with their schoolwork and clean up with them.
Being kind, honest, and respectful makes me a good example for my siblings.
I can share things with them and listen to them to be a good example.

questions.question: What should you do to be a good student?
questions.translation: ماذا يجب أن تفعل لتكون طالباً جيداً؟
suggested_answers: I should respect my teachers, do my homework, and keep my grades up.
To be a good student, I should listen in class, study hard, and participate.
A good student is punctual, does homework, and respects the teacher.

questions.question: How can you make your parents happy?
suggested_answers: I can make my parents happy by showing love and being kind.
Doing well at school and being responsible makes my parents happy.
I make my parents happy when I respect them, help them, and follow their advice.

questions.question: How can you make friends from different countries?
questions.translation: كيف يمكنك تكوين صداقات من بلدان مختلفة؟
suggested_answers: I can sign up on a pen pal website and create a profile with my interests.
I can write messages and share my interests with people from other countries.
Learning a foreign language helps me make friends from different countries.

questions.question: Why is it useful to learn a foreign language?
questions.translation: لماذا من المفيد تعلم لغة أجنبية؟
suggested_answers: It is useful to learn a foreign language because it helps us communicate with others.
Learning a foreign language helps us build bonds and make friends.
A foreign language opens the door to new cultures and helps us travel and work.

questions.question: What helps you to make friends wherever you go?
questions.translation: ما الذي يساعدك على تكوين صداقات أينما ذهبت؟
suggested_answers: Being polite and nice helps me make friends wherever I go.
If I am willing to learn and try new experiences, I can make friends easily.
Being kind, open, and curious about others helps me make friends.

questions.question: What should you remember about people in other countries?
questions.translation: ماذا يجب أن تتذكر عن الناس في البلدان الأخرى؟
suggested_answers: I should remember that people in other countries have different cultures and life styles.
I should respect their privacy, traditions, and customs.
People in other countries have different values and religions, and we should respect them.
